statements.t: Adjusted Non-GAAP presentation - We believe that the adjusted non-GAAP presentation of the current and prior period information presented on the following pages provides stockholders and other interested persons with useful information regarding certain financial metrics that may assist such persons in analyzing our operating results as they develop a future earnings outlook for us.

We anticipate reporting an effective tax rate of approximately 24.5% to 26.5% in the brokerage segment and 25.0% to 27.0% in the risk management segment for the foreseeable future.
We estimate future earnout payments using the earnout formula and performance targets specified in each purchase agreement and these financial projections.
We anticipate reporting an effective tax rate of approximately 24.5% to 26.5% in our brokerage segment based on known changes in tax rates in future periods.
We anticipate reporting an effective tax rate on adjusted results of approximately 25.0% to 27.0% in our risk management segment based on known changes in tax rates in future periods.
Clean energy-related - This consists of the operating results related to our investments in clean energy projects, primarily fusion and carbon sequestration projects.

Historically, our capital requirements have primarily included dividend payments on our common stock, repurchases of our common stock, funding of our investments, acquisitions of brokerage and risk management operations and capital expenditures, including investments being made in IT and software development projects.

In 2026, we expect total expenditures for capital improvements to be approximately $180 million (includes the impact of acquisitions closed through September 30, 2026), part of which is related to expenditures on office moves and investments being made in IT and software development projects.

For the remainder of 2026, we expect to use cash on hand, new debt, our Credit Agreement, cash from operations and our common stock, or a combination thereof to fund all of the acquisitions we complete.

Our board of directors determines dividends on our common stock on a quarterly basis after considering our available cash from earnings, our anticipated cash needs and current conditions in the economy and financial markets.
We make no assurances regarding when, or if, we will issue any securities under this registration statement.
We intend to use the net proceeds of sales under this program to fund future acquisitions from time to time or for general corporate purposes.
Outlook - We believe that we have sufficient capital and access to additional capital to meet our short- and long-term cash flow needs.
